optimiser_adamw_fp32.note: two fp32 moments over the trainable elements

utility_label_phase.note: forward-only, no gradients, micro_positions=256 sub-batches under inference_mode while the optimiser state is resident

components_note: weights and chunked logits only; the runtime's CUDA context, cuBLAS workspaces and load transients are named by the measured peak, not by this sum

device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER
device.usable_basis: device total less the desktop compositor's resident allocation; the binding constraint on this host

host_limits.note: host RAM limit for the court container; VRAM is not a cgroup resource and is bounded by the arithmetic above

kill_condition: stop the container if any step in train.jsonl reports vram_peak_gib above 12.5 GiB (12.5 of 15.6 usable); the failure is then recorded with its cgroup evidence instead of retried at the same limit
verdict: the 1.5x rule over the predicted peak does not fit on this card; the launch is authorised on a measured bound instead: the same geometry's measured reserved peak plus the declared allowance, with the kill condition below enforced from the first logged step
